inputs.proposal: Simplify the J2534 read paths: take the vendor's reported message count as the number of frames delivered in both the in-process loader and the surrogate, and drop the qttune_trusted_count helper from j2534_ptypes.h.

questions:
claim: Removal of qttune_trusted_count filtering removes critical safety measure against stale vendor counts. The original code had documented that some vendors leave pNumMsgs untouched on error ('status 7, written 1' observed on OBDX Pro VX), and the filtering prevented using counts that shouldn't be trusted. Removing this exposes the code to phantom frame replay in the surrogate's static buffer and incorrect frame processing in the loader.; file: core/src/j2534_loader.cpp; quote: long rc = handle->read_msgs(channel, &msg, &num, timeout_ms);
    num = qttune_trusted_count(rc, num);   /* finding 1: dirty count
                                               under a hard error is
                                               not a delivered frame */
nits: The helper function's logic appears incomplete - the comment mentions ERR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW should also be trusted, but the switch statement only has STATUS_NOERROR and STATUS_TIMEOUT cases. This discrepancy should be investigated.
The j2534_loader.cpp code should validate num against the actual buffer size to prevent potential buffer overflow if num is unexpectedly large.
